Metadata.Title: FIFA 14
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS in replays and cutscenes
Metadata.Note: Keeps replays and cutscenes at 60 FPS. ELF 0xE88A34: flip interval clamp 3 -> 1. ELF 0xE27B97 / 0xE27B9F: end of frame wait for intervals 3 and 2, 50 / 33 ms -> 16 ms.
Metadata.Author: danilenko22

Metadata.Title: FIFA 14
Metadata.Name: Scene limiter 40 -> 60
Metadata.Note: Raises the 40 Hz scene scheduler limiter (ELF 0x401D03, call at 0x401D08) to 60 Hz.
Metadata.Author: danilenko22
